purpose.domain_detail: CCVS85 (COBOL Compiler Validation System 1985) conformance test suite, specifically testing the intrinsic function ORD
purpose.summary: This is program IF127A from the CCVS85 COBOL compiler validation test suite. It tests the COBOL-85 intrinsic function ORD, which returns the ordinal position of a character in the collating sequence. The program runs a series of pass/fail tests and writes results to a print file.
